sentences.en: The face will leave in you an utterly different impression.
sentences.zh: 这张脸会在你心中留下完全不同的印象。

sentences.en: I'm afraid the story will give him a wrong impression.
sentences.zh: 恐怕这个故事会给他留下错误的印象。

sentences.en: My first impression was that he was a tactful politician.
sentences.zh: 我最初的印象是他是个圆滑的政治家。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：impress（印，盖印）+ion →印象，盖印
